name: Fournier’s Brand Relationship Quality (BRQ) Model
diagnostic: What specific relational contract does our brand form with the customer, and do our operational touchpoints reinforce or break that contract?
artifact: Six facets — Love/Passion, Self-Connection, Interdependence, Commitment, Intimacy, Brand Partner Quality — scored across relationship archetypes such as Committed Partnership or Secret Fling.
trap: Using an intimate, conversational tone when the business reality is an opportunistic transaction reads as false.
pedigreeFull: Susan Fournier (Journal of Consumer Research, 1998). An academic framework analyzing consumer-brand connections as active socio-emotive relationships.
artifactFull: A 6-Facet Relational Typology Map evaluating Love/Passion, Self-Connection, Interdependence, Commitment, Intimacy, and Brand Partner Quality across relationship archetypes (e.g., Committed Partnership, Marriage of Convenience, Childhood Friendship, Secret Fling).
trapFull: Adopting an intimate, conversational tone in marketing when the underlying business reality is an opportunistic transaction, triggering customer skepticism.
